description: POA 2.0 as a function of its command line and the text of the files it names (PoaProgram.Run): poa -read_fasta FILE [-do_global] [-do_progressive] [-read_pairscores FILE] [-fuse_all] [-hb] [-hbmin X] [-best] [-preserve_seqorder] [-tolower] [-toupper] [-pir FILE] [-clustal FILE] [-po FILE] [-printmatrix LETTERS] [-v] MATRIXFILE, with the program's argument loop (every argument is tested against every flag; unknown flags are ignored; the first argument that does not start with a dash is the matrix file). Output: the PIR / CLUSTAL / PO files named by -pir / -clustal / -po, standard output (-v gap penalty tables, -printmatrix, the permutation line of -preserve_seqorder). Exit code 1 = the program stops with an error (no matrix or unreadable matrix, no sequence file, no sequences, conflicting flags), 255 = called without arguments (usage). The alignment progress lines of standard error are not reproduced (the program prints uninitialised %ld arguments there); the '...Read N sequences...' / '...Wrote N sequences...' lines are. -read_msa / -read_msa2 / -read_msa_list / -subset / -remove are not ported (NotSupportedException, registered). VERIFICATION: exit code, standard output and the three output files equal the installed Debian poa 2.0+20060928 on 359 / 359 committed command lines.

arguments.description: The command-line arguments of poa, one per element (for example ["-read_fasta", "in.fa", "-clustal", "out.aln", "blosum80.mat"]).

files.description: The text of the files the arguments name: file name -> text (FASTA file, matrix file, pair-score file).

exitCode.description: 0 = success, 1 = the program stops with an error, 255 = no arguments (usage).

stdout.description: Standard output: -v gap tables, -printmatrix table, the permutation line of -preserve_seqorder.

stderr.description: Error messages and the "...Read N sequences..." / "...Wrote N sequences..." lines (the alignment progress lines are not reproduced).

errors.message: -read_msa / -read_msa2 / -read_msa_list (accepted by the program, not ported): NotSupportedException

examples.name: CLUSTAL output with the gap penalty tables (poa -read_fasta in.fa -clustal out.aln -v m.mat)

files.m.mat:
# demo
GAP-PENALTIES=12 6 6
 A R N D
A 7 -3 -3 -3
R -3 9 -1 -3
N -3 -1 9 2
D -3 -3 2 10
